sources: cpwshop campsiteDetails pages for every Main and West Side site, read 2026-10-27

hookups.source: https://cpw.state.co.us/state-parks/mancos-state-park/mancos-state-park-camping-lodging ('There are no electrical hook-ups at Mancos'; 'basic campsites'; 'Spigots with potable water to fill jugs') + cpwshop campsiteDetails (every site 'Basic' or 'Tent', no hookup listed), read 2026-10-27

values.note: 23 sites on the south side of the reservoir (Main; the booking site lists 22: vehicle lengths 24 ft at 11, 25-40 ft at 9, and 14 and 21 ft at one each; 3 pull-through) and 9 on the northwest side (West Side), primarily tent sites - three take a 24-ft vehicle. Two drive-up yurts. CPW calls the campsites 'best suited for tent campers'.

sites.source: https://cpw.state.co.us/state-parks/mancos-state-park/mancos-state-park-camping-lodging ('The park has 32 campsites, including 23 located on the south side of the reservoir ... Along the northwest side of the reservoir, there are nine campsites, primarily for tent campers'; 'basic campsites best suited for tent campers as well as yurts') + cpwshop campsiteDetails (Site Type, Maximum Vehicle Length, Driveway Entry), read 2026-10-27

values.note: Drinking water only at the main (south) campground; the northwest sites have restrooms but no water nearby. The dump station is at the campground exit.

facilities.source: https://cpw.state.co.us/state-parks/mancos-state-park/mancos-state-park-camping-lodging ('There are vault toilets and drinking water but no electrical hookups or showers. Along the northwest side ... restrooms but no drinking water nearby'; 'Spigots with potable water to fill jugs'; 'Dump station') + brochure ('A dump station is located at the exit leaving the campground'), read 2026-10-27

values.note: In winter the west campground closes and several upper-loop sites of the main campground stay open; winter amenities are vault toilets.

season.source: https://cpw.state.co.us/state-parks/mancos-state-park/mancos-state-park-camping-lodging ('Open to the public year-round'; 'During the winter months, the west campground is closed, but several campsites in the upper loop of the main campground remain open'; 'Winter amenities: Vault toilets'), read 2026-10-27

values.note: A reservation is required year-round: cpwshop.com or 1-800-244-5613, up to six months ahead. 14 days within a 28-day period; six people and one camping unit per site. Check-in 1 p.m., check-out noon. Display a vehicle pass.

booking.source: https://cpw.state.co.us/state-parks/mancos-state-park/mancos-state-park-camping-lodging ('A reservation is required to camp at Mancos State Park ... cpwshop.com or by phone at 1-800-244-5613. Reservations can be made up to six months in advance'; 'Yurts and campsites must be reserved year-round at Mancos'; 'The maximum stay is 14 days within a 28-day period'), read 2026-10-27

values.note: Basic sites: West Side $20, Main $22 a night, the same in January and June and on a Saturday. Plus tax, CPW's per-stay reservation fee, and a daily vehicle pass or an annual Colorado state parks pass.

fees.source: cpwshop campsiteDetails, arrival Tue Jan 12, 2027 and Sat Jun 19, 2027 (Main Basic '$22.00 /Per Night'; West Side Basic '$20.00 /Per Night'), read 2026-10-27

note: Ponderosa-pine campground beside Jackson Gulch Reservoir north of Mancos (Mesa Verde country). --Claude
summary: CPW camping page + brochure + every cpwshop site page: confirmed no hookups, max rig 40 ft, pull-throughs (3), year-round with the west campground closed in winter, $20-22, reservation-only. Changed sites 23 -> 32 (23 south + 9 northwest, per CPW); added water/sewer false, vault toilets, spigot water, dump, no showers, deep link, 180-day window, fcfs never, 14-night max. Note: dropped the field restatements (site count/length, no electric, pull-through, winter loop, reservable).
flags: Re-pin: stored 37.3999,-108.2693 is on the park road by the dam, ~510 m north of the centroid of the 22 Main sites (37.39530,-108.27063). Suggest the Main centroid.

SPLIT CHECK: the West Side campground (8 sites: 3 basic taking a 24-ft vehicle, 5 tent) is on the reservoir's northwest/north shore, centroid 37.40913,-108.26790, ~1.5 km from Main by straight line and reached by a separate road around the reservoir. Only 3 RV-capable sites, 24 ft max, no water, closed in winter - probably not worth its own entry; flag for AWH.

Waterfront: Main (stored 'not waterfront' fits) sits in ponderosa forest south of and below the dam, ~150-500 m from the water. cpwshop marks all 8 West Side sites 'Lakefront'; on Esri imagery (reservoir drawn down) they sit ~50-150 m above the current waterline. Not relevant to this entry unless West Side is split.
Fit: CPW says the sites are 'best suited for tent campers'; even so, 20 of the 22 Main sites take 24 ft or more (sites 012 at 21 ft and 013 at 14 ft don't).
